exposure_audit.scope: recorded composer audits, mining provenance, pairs, solving runs and binary-input source exposure
limits: Not a complete log of human inspection or unrecorded sessions.
Known-problem lookup/index validation is separate exposure, not composer training.
Prior foundation-model training exposure is unknown.

requirements: separate teacher-only artifacts excluded from student and search access
frozen codec and complete input/resource bounds
all primitive, port, binding, effect, literal and recipe features supported in fit
no fit/audit expanded-pattern or sibling-family overlap
public and independent oracle qualification; retain invalid test-suite exclusions
retain every unsupported target and reason in fixed-pool coverage denominator
freeze admitted targets before training; no protected feedback into vocabulary or model selection
target_qualification.scope: Pattern novelty and complete support must be certified; metadata reservation establishes neither.

comparison.question: Can one parallel prediction assemble a correct unfamiliar typed program faster than bounded search?
comparison.decision_budget_scope: same warm request budget for every route including public checking; timeout is abstention

search.shared_space: same typed grammar, graph limits, constants, bindings and expansions as predictor
search.ordering: unguided uses canonical order; guided changes ranking only
search.feedback: public examples only; independent scoring never guides search

retrieval.allowed: frozen fit-side graphs and admitted component contracts only
retrieval.embedding: same locally available hash-verified Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B across guided routes

development_selection.rule: highest development first-graph independent correctness; then lower complete latency; then smaller head

pre_evaluation_seal: qualified protected cohort and rejection receipt hashes
primary_metrics: first-graph correctness on supported teacher-qualified cohort

timing.complete: embedding + retrieval + prediction/search + assembly + public checking; include failures
timing.timing_policy: freeze all predictions before scoring; repeat frozen routes without changing checkpoints or decisions

comparison.acceptance: Report correctness/coverage and latency jointly; faster abstention is not a solving win.
comparison.correctness: Independent execution agreement accepts any valid graph; exact teacher graph match is diagnostic only.
comparison.evaluation: One scoring pass of every sealed route, no result-driven changes or replacement tasks; interrupted runs keep their identity.
comparison.generative_control: Existing 80.2% Codex result is historical, not matched to this pool. A fresh matched control requires its own pre-score seal; no provider launched here.
